ffaIntro: B2B e-commerce Project Lead / Product Manager at FFA, during a KEDGE work-study placement (2025–2026). Rebuild the storefront and connect orders, stock, shipping and invoicing.
ffaCompany: FFA sells French apéritif products and gift boxes to consumers and businesses. Work-study placement alongside KEDGE, 2025–2026.
ffaProblem: An ageing WordPress storefront and fragmented operations: orders copied between systems, shipping labels created manually and invoices entered one by one.
ffaRole: Product discovery, roadmap ownership and prioritisation; aligning engineering, operations and marketplace stakeholders from specification to release.
ffaDelivery: A Shopify Plus B2B/B2C rebuild with Erplain inventory sync, Mirakl integrations and an n8n workflow connecting orders, shipping and invoicing. URL redirects and canonical mappings were preserved through the migration.
ffaOutcome: Delivery scope, 2025–2026: WordPress replaced by Shopify Plus; 367 SKUs, five marketplace channels and one connected order/shipping/invoice workflow.
ffaDeclaredResults: Reported results: −40% administrative workload and zero manual entries in the core workflow. Reference period, baseline and measurement method remain to be documented.
ffaWorkflowCaption: Illustrated FFA order architecture · not an application screenshot.
ffaWholesaleText: Company accounts, customer-specific prices, draft orders and deferred payment terms. Real-time stock mapping across 367 SKUs, with recurring orders and seasonal bundles.
ffaChannelsText: AstoreShop (Accor), Nature & Découvertes, Veepee, Ankorstore and Kviste: catalogue onboarding, product taxonomy, variant mapping, pricing rules and channel-specific quality checks.
ffaSupportText: An adapted open-source AI chatbot uses a knowledge base built from customer questions and routes conversations by intent and urgency. Kwanko adds affiliate tracking, commission structures and publisher activation.
ffaSecurityText: A Google Maps / Places relay-point selector connects checkout choices to Colissimo labels. Server-side analytics tagging, field-level API mapping and payload validation support reliable downstream workflows.

leadIntro: A B2B prospecting platform you can pilot through a conversation with its Gemini-powered copilot: research accounts, prepare outreach and coordinate specialised agents.
leadConversationText: Describe your goal to the copilot in natural language. It uses page context to guide prospect research, qualify records, prepare campaigns and coordinate specialised agents. Proposed data changes are presented before application. The conversational intelligence uses the Google Gemini API.
leadProblem: Scattered prospect data, repetitive qualification and disconnected outreach make B2B prospecting slow and inconsistent.
leadRole: Product ownership and implementation: frame multi-client prospecting needs, prioritise the research-to-outreach workflow and define acceptance criteria for sources, contact review and explicit sending actions.
leadDelivery: Public-source company discovery, traceable enrichment and contact verification, a Kanban pipeline and outbound sequences. Built with Next.js, TypeScript and PostgreSQL, with an Expo mobile app and Chrome extension.
leadOutcome: A live B2B prospecting application with conversational control, specialised agents and a Chrome capture extension.
leadArchitectureText: The earlier workflow described on my portfolio connected public company sources, Apollo and LinkedIn research to n8n, Brevo sequences and HubSpot. The current SaaS extends this into organisation-based prospecting, contact verification and outbound tools.
leadRepo1: A free-first discovery waterfall starts with SIRENE and public sources, then uses configured enrichment providers. Contacts keep their source and verification status.
leadRepo2: Organisation-based workspaces separate prospect data, provider credentials and quotas. Campaigns, a Kanban pipeline and outbound sequences share the same prospect records.
leadRepo3: The product combines a contextual AI copilot, email checks, Resend/SMTP sending and progressive mailbox warmup, alongside an Expo client and Chrome extension.
leadEcoNote: Hunter, Apollo and Kaspr are configurable connectors using the organisation’s own account. LinkedIn profiles are captured through the LeadHunt extension.
leadRuntimeEcoNote: Service availability depends on the configured organisation and provider accounts.
carIntro: Product ownership for an accessible vehicle-inspection journey: help buyers, owners and mechanics turn observations into checks, a clear report and the next action.
carProblem: Before buying or maintaining a vehicle, a non-specialist needs to know what to inspect, how to record the facts and when to seek professional help. Scattered observations, fault codes and documents make that decision harder.
carOrigin: Personal engine restoration, rally safety work and simracing made one problem tangible: recognising a symptom does not tell a non-specialist what to check next. Cardiag turns that field interest into a guided, documented inspection journey.
carRole: Product Owner: frame the buyer, owner and workshop journeys; define the inspection backlog, prioritise the first usable local workflow and translate the scope into user stories and observable acceptance criteria. Technical choices support continuity in the field and a readable vehicle record.
carDelivery: The responsive web app is available on desktop and mobile. A shared Expo codebase targets Android and iOS; native distribution is separate from availability in a mobile browser. Local inspections, verified-account sync and PDF reports connect field observations to the vehicle record.
carOutcome: Public release since September 2026, with approximately ten users (owner-reported). The web app offers a 12-point quick inspection, 33 full checks and a catalogue of 201 makes.
carDecisionChecks: Seven inspection areas organise documents, engine, chassis, bodywork, equipment, road test and the final summary. The full 33-check path keeps that coverage explicit; the 12-point selection lowers the effort of a first pass. A quick inspection is not presented as equivalent to a complete one.
carDecisionLocal: Keep recording usable beside the vehicle when connectivity varies. Inspection data is stored on the device; verified-account sync can then share supported records between devices. Photos remain local. The Gemini assistant requires an online connection.
carDecisionModel: A catalogue of 201 makes links the selected model, generation and engine to documented recurring faults. That context helps prioritise the next checks; it does not establish that a known fault is present on the inspected vehicle.
carPriorityMust: Must: identify the vehicle, complete quick/full checks, preserve local observations and export an understandable PDF.
carPriorityShould: Should: enrich the record with model-specific risks, guided symptom analysis and verified-account synchronisation.
carPriorityLater: Outside the current integrated scope: Stripe collection, automatic purchases from parts suppliers and included third-party history reports. These remain configuration work or external services.
carAcceptanceRecord: Each observation, comment and photo stays attached to the selected vehicle and inspection check; saved local data can be resumed.
carAcceptanceProgress: The selected mode exposes 12 or 33 checks. Progress represents completion, with unanswered checks remaining visible; it is not a reliability certificate.
carAcceptanceReport: The PDF identifies the vehicle and distinguishes recorded observations, photos, completed checks and points requiring attention.
carAudienceBuyer: Buyers: inspect a used vehicle step by step before purchase, identify points to check and keep a detailed inspection sheet.
carAudienceOwner: Owners: bring together observations, inspections and OBD readings to track the vehicle’s condition over time.
carAudienceGarage: Mechanics: structure diagnosis, document checks and prepare an intervention using the vehicle record and workshop workflow.
carInspectionText: Choose a 12-point quick inspection or 33 checks across seven areas. Plain-language steps help non-specialists know what to observe and record. Completion measures the checks entered, not vehicle reliability.
carCatalogTitle: Model-specific knowledge, not a generic checklist
carCatalogText: The extensive catalogue covers 201 makes and 2,697 model entries, with generations and engine variants. Documented recurring problems highlight symptoms to look for, affected components, usual mileage ranges and indicative costs, with guidance on the next checks for the selected vehicle.
carConversationTitle: Describe a symptom, build a diagnosis
carConversationText: The conversational agent, powered by the Google Gemini API, asks targeted questions and combines the vehicle context with symptoms, observations and fault codes. It helps narrow down likely root causes and prepare checks, with indicative repair costs and labour times refined through measurements and workshop inspection.
carPdfTitle: A detailed PDF, before purchase and over time
carPdfText: Generate a detailed vehicle inspection sheet in PDF format, bringing together vehicle identification, completed checks, recorded observations, photos and points requiring attention. Use it as a practical pre-purchase checklist or keep it with the vehicle record to preserve traceability of its condition and subsequent inspections.
carRepo1: Client → vehicle → repair order → quote → recorded approval → intervention → invoice → recorded payment → maintenance reminder. Stock is consumed when work is completed.
carRepo2: Web, Android and iOS share an Expo codebase. Local records work before sign-in; verified-account sync handles version conflicts. Photos remain on the originating device.
carRepo3: Quotes and invoices can be printed or exported as PDFs. Customer approvals, supplier orders and payment records are currently manual; a PDF export does not process a payment.
carEcoNote: History reports and parts sourcing currently use external links and manual records. Partner API access and Stripe activation remain configuration milestones.
carScreenDiagnostic: Conversational diagnosis — Gemini assistant and technical synthesis
carScreenFaults: Recurring model faults — symptoms, costs and checks
carGalleryHint: Explore vehicle identification and recurring faults. Open an image to read it in full.
secoursIntro: A first-aid assistance prototype exploring triage, offline guidance, consent and a responder's route.
secoursNotes: Phase-one prototype with a demo mode and embedded tutorials. The product is an assistance concept, not a replacement for emergency services. Deployment and real-world validation remain separate milestones.
secoursEcoNote: Consent is recorded before location use. Offline tutorials are bundled; responder navigation opens Waze, Google Maps or Apple Maps. SMS and critical notifications remain future work.

rencontreEcoNote: QR and vCard sharing, consent-based public profiles, private contact notes and JSON export/deletion. The assistant extracts PDF/DOCX CV text into structured profile data. Event management is on the V2 roadmap.

careerNotes: Adapted from the open-source career-ops project with company career-page tracking, a résumé studio and owner-only access. The workflow prepares decisions; it does not automatically submit applications.
careerEcoNote: Tracks company career pages and matches role keywords. The résumé studio keeps private drafts, previews and PDF/HTML exports. Its completeness checklist is explainable; applications and outreach stay manual.

remoteEcoNote: Text, photos and CPU-transcribed voice can drive local tools. Named webhooks, a bounded repair loop and an audit journal support the workflow; an external model API is optional.

ansysIntro: A B2B proposal for Dassault Aviation use cases: accelerate simulation iterations while retaining certified physics solvers, expert validation and on-premise data control.
ansysConfirmed: Ansys hackathon · KEDGE Business School · 2026 · 1st place, Innovation.
ansysContext: Ansys hackathon at KEDGE Business School · 2026 · 1st place, Innovation category. B2B proposal for AI-assisted simulation.
ansysOffers: AeroSignal AI: electromagnetic antenna integration. AeroShape AI: aerodynamic geometry screening. Aero Twin Ops: maintenance and reduced-order models. Sovereign Secure AI: on-premise deployment and a persona-based go-to-market strategy.
ansysValidation: Rafale and Falcon cases frame the proposal. Uncertain predictions return to rigorous solvers and human experts; this is a hackathon commercial concept.

dtcIntro: Creating e-commerce brands and running the full business: identity, storefronts, supplier negotiation, acquisition and international sales.
dtcMiniCase: Women’s jewellery and pet accessories: design the identity and packaging, build a Shopify or WooCommerce store and its social channels, negotiate stock and freight with suppliers in China and Turkey, then combine affiliate traffic and paid campaigns. Amazon/eBay and cash-on-delivery operations extend the distribution model.
dtcBrandsBody: Created brands in women’s jewellery and accessories, and pet accessories. Built more than 20 e-commerce stores using Shopify and WordPress / WooCommerce, alongside Amazon and eBay sales channels.
dtcIdentityBody: Designed the brand identity from the logo to product packaging, then created each brand’s presence on Instagram, Facebook and TikTok.
dtcSupplyBody: Worked with suppliers in China and Turkey. Negotiated stock purchases, shipping costs and lead times, as well as storage arrangements.
dtcAffiliationBody: Ran affiliate campaigns with influencers and previous customers to generate organic traffic and support sales beyond the home market.
dtcAdsBody: Created and managed Google Ads, Meta Ads and TikTok Ads campaigns, with responsibility for advertising budgets and margins.
dtcInternationalBody: Sold worldwide and operated cash on delivery in African and Middle Eastern markets: customers pay when their order is delivered.
dtcOperationsNote: Full P&L ownership, supported by a remote team in the Philippines working through asynchronous workflows and KPI dashboards.

missionSITText: Quality-project management: frame objectives, map processes and coordinate improvement action plans. FMEA structures risk prioritisation; PDCA, root-cause analysis and Lean Six Sigma guide corrective actions, waste reduction and follow-up within an ISO 9001 quality framework.

missionWebmediaText: Software quality assurance at the interface between support and development: technical-ticket analysis, reproducible bug diagnosis, functional test plans and release verification. Root-cause investigation and PDCA structure corrective actions, retesting and feedback into the next delivery cycle.
experience-mascirIntro: Applying risk analysis and QHSE practices to medical-device operations.
missionMascirText: QHSE risk mapping, FMEA, contractor audits and chemical-safety oversight in medical-device operations. PDCA action plans connect findings to prevention and cross-departmental improvement, drawing on ISO 9001 quality, ISO 14001 environmental management and the historical OHSAS 18001 occupational-safety framework.
experience-schaefflerIntro: Combining production quality, preventive methods and document traceability.
missionSchaefflerText: Production quality in an automotive environment, drawing on IATF 16949 and ISO 9001. FMEA prioritises failure risks and preventive controls; 8D problem solving, root-cause analysis and PDCA support lasting corrective actions. A digital archive strengthens document traceability and retrieval.
experience-alliancesIntro: Assessing information-system security and prioritising remediation.
missionAlliancesText: Organisational and technical information-security assessment, ISO/IEC 27001 gap analysis and risk prioritisation. Findings become a progressive remediation roadmap, with documented recommendations, action ownership and project follow-up.
experience-tgrIntro: Developing and testing an internal portal for employee workflows.
missionTGRText: Development and QA of an internal employee portal, including SQL stored procedures. Functional test plans, validation environments and issue follow-up connect the requirements to verified backend behaviour and release acceptance.
